text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Follow one campaign down the line. One command reads the recipe: the flat sheet, eleven diffusivities. The launcher opens one task per setting; each integrates sixteen runs side by side and writes one file. Each task adds a ledger row: its status, checksum and wall time.
